title: The New Neighbourhood
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
My name is Li Hua. I live in a new neighbourhood in Shanghai. There are many tall buildings here. There is a small park near my home. In the park, there are some trees and flowers. There is a lake in the park, too. The water is clean. There are some ducks on the lake. I like the park very much.

There is a supermarket on the corner of the street. It is open from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. There are many things in the supermarket. You can buy food, drinks, and clothes there. There is a bus stop in front of the supermarket. Buses come every ten minutes. It is very convenient.

There is a library behind my building. It is quiet. There are many books in the library. I often go there to read. There is a coffee shop next to the library. The coffee is nice. There are some tables and chairs outside. People like to sit there and talk.

There is a school near the park. It is big and new. There are many students in the school. They study hard. There is a hospital on the left of the school. It is open 24 hours. There are doctors and nurses there. They help people.

My neighbourhood is nice. There are many places to go. I am happy here.

options: In a new neighbourhood in Shanghai
In an old neighbourhood in Beijing
In a big city in the UK

grammar.title: There be 句型与可数/不可数名词
grammar.explanation: 英语中表示“某处有某物”常用 There be 句型。be 动词的形式取决于后面的名词：单数可数名词或不可数名词用 is，复数可数名词用 are。some 用于肯定句，any 用于否定句和疑问句。
grammar.example: There is a small park near my home. There are some ducks on the lake.

questions.prompt: There ______ a book on the desk.
questions.explanation: book 是单数可数名词，所以用 is。
questions.evidence: There is a book on the desk.

questions.prompt: There ______ some apples in the basket.
questions.explanation: apples 是复数可数名词，所以用 are。
questions.evidence: There are some apples in the basket.

questions.prompt: There isn't ______ milk in the fridge.
questions.explanation: 否定句中用 any 表示“一些”。
questions.evidence: There isn't any milk in the fridge.

questions.prompt: Are there ______ books on the shelf?
questions.explanation: 疑问句中用 any 表示“一些”。
questions.evidence: Are there any books on the shelf?
